newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Steady to up in thin activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Steady to up in thin activity.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were mostly steady to higher amid thin activity on Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none on Monday.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 117-1/2 percent of tariff, similar, up 2-1/2 percent from Monday, one barge offered at 120 percent, similar unchanged.
- One barge, Memphis, Mississippi River, $500 switch, this week, no bid, offer 90 percent, unchanged from July 26.
